ns2:course.label: Mechanical Behavior of Metals
ns2:course.description: Mechanical behavior of solids: crystal plasticity, dislocations, point defects and grain boundaries, creep and fatigue behavior, and fracture. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MSE 406.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MSE 406.
